tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Find Kolo Verify services that answer what a homeowner is worried about, in their own words (e.g. "my builder quotes don't compare", "is my floor plan wasting space", "can I trust this contract"). Returns the best matches with prices and booking links, and the homeowner worries they matched.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Every Kolo Verify service on sale, grouped by the stage of the build it belongs to (architect, floor plan and design, budget, builder, quotations, contract…), with entry prices, turnaround and booking links.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Everything about one Kolo Verify service: its packages and what each adds, prices, turnaround, what you get, what is and is not included, how it works, what to keep ready, FAQs, homeowner ratings where there are enough, and the booking link.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Kolo Verify's packs: several services bought together for less than their parts, with what each contains, the pack price, the saving and the booking link.

tools.name: how_to_order
tools.description: How to buy from Kolo Verify: where services are sold, the minimum order and platform fee, how payment works, refunds, upgrade credit, and the Kolo promise.
